description:
Make archive discovery resolve every embedded reference once, when its artifact is parsed, and compute reachability once per distinct document root instead of once per linking document.

## Background

- `ParsedArtifact` (`crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_discovery.rs:31-35`) stores the raw `references: Vec<String>`. `resolve_reference` (`artifact_discovery.rs:633`) is a pure function of the parent path and the reference, yet it runs at three sites over the same parsed references: closure expansion in `expand_artifact_closure` (`:261`), inventory discovery in `discover_archive_artifacts` through `followed_references` (`:293-305`, resolved at `:413`), and every reachability walk in `reachable_parsed_paths` (`:536-555`, resolved at `:548`).
- `discover_embedded_owners` (`artifact_discovery.rs:501-534`) calls `reachable_parsed_paths` once per (issue, unpinned document). Two issues that link one document walk it twice, and each walk resolves every reference again.
- `parse_artifact` (`artifact_discovery.rs:612`) knows the parent path when it extracts references, so it can store each reference beside its resolution.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ParsedArtifact` carries each extracted reference together with its `ReferenceResolution`, computed once in `parse_artifact`; closure expansion, discovery and reachability read the stored resolution, and no other production code in the module calls `resolve_reference`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Embedded-owner discovery computes the reachable path set once per distinct normalized document root and derives every (issue, document) owner from that one set.
- [hard] REQ-03: Unit tests in the module show that each stored resolution equals `resolve_reference(parent, reference)` for the parsed reference, and that two issues linking the same document root produce the same embedded owners as walking each link separately while the per-root reachability map holds one entry per distinct root.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged: the existing discovery and archive tests pass without edits to their assertions.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Archive discovery resolves each reference once
